verdict.rationale: Jitsu does not document a built-in natural-language interface, but it ships its own official MCP server. That server is explicitly built so a user's AI agent can operate the product: configure the pipeline, create destinations, wire up streams, inspect Live Events and fix Functions. Natural-language operation therefore works only through an external agent client the user brings. missing for 10: a native in-product natural-language command interface, hands-on or independent corroboration that agent-driven operation works in practice, and documentation of which operations are covered beyond the listed examples.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: Jitsu runs an MCP server, so AI agents can manage your pipeline directly: create destinations, wire up streams, inspect Live Events, and edit Functions.
Point your AI agent at the Jitsu MCP server and it can configure your pipeline, watch Live Events in real time, and fix the Functions that transform your data
Point your agent at `https://use.jitsu.com/mcp`, approve it once in the browser, and it can run your data pipeline for you.
